purpose: Starts the real page server and requests a page over loopback and from another address, and checks the second cannot connect.
title: Pages answer on the Mac only

testCases.description: A page Squire made is served to a request from the Mac itself, byte for byte
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::a page Squire made is served to a request from the Mac itself, its bytes as they are

testCases.description: The home dashboard is served from the Mac by the same page server
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::the home dashboard is served from the Mac by the same page server

testCases.description: The comment panel's post from the Mac is taken and kept in the owner's folder
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::the comment panel's post from the Mac is taken and the note is kept in the owner's folder

testCases.description: From another address a page, the dashboard and the comment post are refused, and no comment is kept
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::from another address on the network a page, the home dashboard and the comment panel's post are all refused, and no comment is kept

testCases.description: Another site's page in the owner's browser is refused: a renamed host, a cross-site comment post; no comment kept
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::a page from another site open in the owner's browser on the Mac is refused: a request under another host name, and a comment posted from another site, and no comment is kept

testCases.description: A comment post without the server's own Origin (none, null, not an origin) is refused, and nothing is kept
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::a comment post that does not carry the server's own Origin is refused: none at all, a null Origin, or one that is not an origin, and no comment is kept

testCases.description: Only the pages folder is served: dots, encoded dots, a link out, the listing and a hidden file are refused
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::only the pages folder is served: a climb out by dots or encoded dots, a link out of the folder, the folder's own listing and a hidden file are each refused, and none of the owner's profile is sent

testCases.description: A kept comment is read as untrusted: after the owner's profile, a send in that job is refused as one job
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::a comment the panel keeps is read as untrusted: a job that has read the owner's profile and then reads a kept comment is refused a send as one job

testCases.description: The link comes from state/page-server.json at that moment: after a restart on another port, --where prints the new address on one line, never the old
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::the link Squire gives the owner comes from state/page-server.json at that moment: after the page server starts again on another port, page-server.py --where prints the new address on one line, never the old one

testCases.description: With no address file, or one naming a process that is not running, --where says the pages are not up, exits non-zero and prints no address
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::with no state/page-server.json, or one naming a page server that is not running, page-server.py --where says the pages are not up, exits non-zero and prints no address

testCases.description: Lay-down writes the page server's agent (the installed page server, --port 0, at load, kept alive) beside the other agents, which stay as they were; no real launchd load
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::lay-down writes the page server's agent beside Squire's other agents, which stay as they were: the installed page server on a port the system gives it, started at load and kept alive, and its load reaches no real launchd domain

testCases.description: From another address on the network, a page, the dashboard and a comment post carrying the page server's own Host and Origin are refused, and no comment is kept
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::from another address on the network, a page, the home dashboard and the comment panel's post that carry the page server's own Host and Origin are all refused, and no comment is kept

testCases.description: The session's link command, spelt as Squire's instructions name it, is free through the safety floor; page-server.py run from the session any other way is refused, yes or no
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::the session's link command, spelt exactly as Squire's instructions name it, goes through the safety floor free with no yes asked; page-server.py run from the session any other way is refused, yes or no

testCases.description: Every command Squire's instructions tell the session to run, read from what lay-down writes, is free or asked by the safety floor exactly as written, never refused outright
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::every command Squire's instructions tell the session to run, read from what lay-down writes for the session, is free or asked by the safety floor exactly as written, never refused outright

testCases.description: the link carries a secret: with it a page, the dashboard and the comment post are served from the Mac; without it or with a wrong one each is refused, saying to ask Squire for the link
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::the link Squire gives carries a secret of the server's own: with it a page, the dashboard and the comment post are served from the Mac; without it, or with a wrong one, each is refused, the refusal saying in one line to ask Squire for the link, and no comment is kept

testCases.description: after the page server starts again, a link from before is refused with all it set, and the new link serves
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::after the page server starts again, a link from before is refused with all it set: a page, the dashboard and the comment post, and no comment is kept; the new link serves them

testCases.description: with no secret kept in the owner's state nothing is served, not even to the link, and no comment is kept
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::with no secret kept in the owner's state nothing is served, not even to the link: a page, the dashboard and the comment post are refused and no comment is kept

testCases.description: the session's link command is free through the floor the lay-down settings run, in the default mode and in auto mode; a start from the session is refused
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::the session's link command goes through the safety floor free as the session runs it (the settings lay-down writes), with no yes, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: a request the page server cannot read is refused with 400 or more and the same framing and script headers as every answer
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::a request from the Mac the page server cannot read (a method it does not know) is refused with an answer of 400 or more that carries the same framing and script headers as every other answer

testCases.description: the comment panel's script is served to the Mac from Squire's own files
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::the comment panel's script, as a page made by Squire links it, is served to the Mac from Squire's own files

testCases.description: what the session loads tells it to run the link command again before it tells the owner the pages are not up
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::what the session loads tells it to run the link command again, at that moment, before it tells the owner the pages are not up, never from what an earlier run said

testCases.description: a refused use of the page server's script is refused, yes or no, in words that name the page server, in both modes
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::a refused use of the page server's script from the session (a help read) is refused, yes or no, with words that name the page server, never the words for a change to Squire's core, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: a look-alike spelling of the page server's script the Mac opens as the same file is refused as the page server's, in both modes
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/pages-on-the-mac.test.js::a look-alike spelling of the page server's script that the Mac opens as the same file (a long s for its s) is the page server's script: started from the session it is refused, yes or no, with words that name the page server, never asked as an unknown command, in the default mode and in auto mode
